content:
COMPLETED / TASK_COMPLETED

End-to-End Browser Audit of Stockfish Chess Arena on http://localhost:5173/ has been completed.

### Visited Origins:
- `http://localhost:5173`

---

### Audit Findings & Verification Results:

1. **Header & Engine Status**:
   - **Status**: PASSED.
   - Header clearly displays "Stockfish Chess Arena", "v1.0 WASM", and subtitle "Grandmaster WebAssembly engine running in dedicated Web Worker".
   - Status badge reliably indicates "Calculating" when Stockfish is computing and "Online" when ready.

2. **Vertical Evaluation Bar**:
   - **Status**: PASSED.
   - Rendered vertically directly to the left of the chessboard container.
   - Dynamically tracks centipawn evaluations (observed: `+0.67`, `-0.89`, `+1.04`, `+1.18`, `+1.32` pawns) with smooth animated fill height and a cyan baseline marker.

3. **Chessboard & Pieces Rendering**:
   - **Status**: DEFECT DETECTED.
   - The board area renders as a blank dark-slate box displaying a single literal `"0"` instead of the 8x8 grid, pieces, and coordinate labels.
   - **Root Cause Analysis**:
     - In `ChessboardContainer.tsx`, `<Chessboard ... />` is instantiated without passing a `boardWidth` prop inside a flex container (`flex items-center justify-center`).
     - `react-chessboard` internally renders `<div ref={boardRef} style={{ width: "100%" }} />` and relies on `ResizeObserver` to set `boardWidth`. Inside the flex container, this element collapses to `0px` width.
     - In React JSX, `{boardWidth && <ChessboardProvider .../>}` evaluates to `0`, outputting literal text `"0"` into the DOM.
   - **Recommended Fix**: Pass an explicit responsive width to `<Chessboard boardWidth={...} />` (or use a container resize observer hook / remove `items-center justify-center` flex collapse on the wrapper).

4. **Competitors Section**:
   - **Status**: PASSED.
   - Displays **Stockfish AI** (GM Engine, WASM Engine, Depth badge D12–D17, live clock ticking down) and **Challenger (You)** (Human Player, live clock ticking down).
   - Turn highlight indicator and active player dot toggle correctly on turn change.

5. **Right-Side Panels**:
   - **Status**: PASSED.
   - **Stockfish Engine Analysis**: Real-time evaluation, advantage breakdown, Suggested Best Move pill (with move coordinates and "Play" button), and Expected Continuation (PV sequence e.g. `1. d4 1... Nd7 2. Nf3 ...`, Depth 17 ply, Nodes >750k, Speed ~6 kN/s).
   - **AI Difficulty Selector**: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert, Custom Search Depth & Time.
   - **Captured Pieces**: White / Black piece counters.
   - **Move History**: Recorded moves formatted cleanly (`1. e4 d6` (2 ply)) with "Copy" and "Download .pgn file" buttons.

6. **Gameplay & Engine Response**:
   - **Status**: PASSED (Engine logic & state machine).
   - Executed opening move `1. e4` via the Suggested Move Play action.
   - Move was instantly recorded in Move History as `1. e4`.
   - Stockfish AI calculated in the background WebAssembly worker and responded with `1... d6`. Move History updated to `1. e4 d6` (2 ply).
   - Clocks decremented accurately during turn time.

7. **Action Controls**:
   - **Status**: PASSED.
   - **Hint Button**: Triggers analysis ("Analyzing...") and displays the emerald hint pill with Stockfish's suggested move (`d4 (d2 → d4)`) and a "Play" button.
   - **Flip Button**: Toggles board orientation perspective (active state confirmed). Second click restores initial perspective.

8. **Console & Exceptions**:
   - **Status**: PASSED. Zero uncaught JavaScript errors or network failures detected in console.

9. **Visual Evidence**:
   - Screenshots of the active match saved at:
     - `C:\Users\DELL\.gemini\antigravity\brain\186c4211-7e2b-42ed-829d-20fef938a184\browser_sandbox\screenshots\step_53_shot_1.png`
     - `C:\Users\DELL\.gemini\antigravity\brain\186c4211-7e2b-42ed-829d-20fef938a184\browser_sandbox\screenshots\step_55_shot_1.png`
